commands.name: get-trending
commands.summary: Trending movies and TV shows today or this week (home page scroller, 20 items)

commands.name: list-popular-home
commands.summary: Home page 'What's Popular' titles by channel (streaming, on TV, in theatres)

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Keyword search on TMDB, filtered to one result type (movie, tv, person, collection, keyword, company, network)

commands.name: discover-movies
commands.summary: Discover movies with filters (genres, keywords, rating, vote count, dates, language, runtime) and sort order, paginated

commands.name: list-movies
commands.summary: Preset movie listings: top rated, now playing, upcoming (use discover-movies with sort_by=popularity.desc for popular)

commands.name: list-tv
commands.summary: Preset TV listings: shows airing today or currently on the air

commands.name: get-movie
commands.summary: Movie details: title, year, certification, US release date, genres, runtime, tagline, overview, director, user score

commands.name: get-movie-cast
commands.summary: Full cast and crew of a movie (name, character or job, person url)

commands.name: get-movie-reviews
commands.summary: User reviews of a movie (author/heading, teaser text, link)

commands.name: get-tv-show
commands.summary: TV series details: name, first-air year, certification, genres, overview, creator, user score, latest season

commands.name: get-tv-season
commands.summary: Episodes of one TV season (number, title, air date, runtime, overview)

commands.name: get-tv-popularity
commands.summary: Daily popularity-rank change chart for a TV show (last 7 days)

commands.name: get-person
commands.summary: Person details: name, biography, personal info (known for, birthday, birthplace), aliases, top known-for title

commands.name: list-popular-people
commands.summary: Popular people on TMDB with their best-known titles, paginated

commands.name: get-collection
commands.summary: Cast and crew credits across a movie collection/franchise (name, roles, person url)

commands.name: list-movies-by-keyword
commands.summary: Movies tagged with a keyword (e.g. space opera), paginated
